1: // Minimal endless‑runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Targets <canvas id="game">
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio context and helper functions
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
7:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
10:     osc.type = 'sine';
11:     osc.connect(gain);
12:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
15:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
17:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
18:   };
19:   const playJumpSound = () => playTone(440, 150);
20:   const playSlideSound = () => playTone(200, 150);
21:   const playGameOverSound = () => playTone(100, 500);
22: 
23:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
24:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
25:   const resize = () => { canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; };
26:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
27:   resize();
28: 
29:   // Player
30:   const player = { w: 30, h: 30, x: 80, y: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false };
31:   const GRAVITY = 0.6, JUMP = -12, SLIDE_FRAMES = 15;
32:   let slide = 0;
33: 
34:   // Obstacles
35:   const obstacles = [];
36:   // clouds for background
37:   const clouds = [];
38:   const CLOUD_SPACING = 300;
39:   const CLOUD_SPEED = 2;
40:   const OB_SPEED = 6, OB_SPACING = 200;
41:   let frame = 0;
42:   const createObstacle = () => {
43:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1; // 0 low, 1 high
44:     const w = 30;
45:     const h = type === 0 ? 30 : canvas.height * 0.4;
46:     const y = type === 0 ? canvas.height - h - 10 : 10;
47:     obstacles.push({ w, h, x: canvas.width + w, y, type });
48:   };
49: 
50:   const keyDown = e => {
51: if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
52:         if (player.onGround) { player.vy = JUMP; player.onGround = false; playJumpSound(); }
53:       } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
54:         if (player.onGround && slide === 0) { slide = SLIDE_FRAMES; playSlideSound(); }
55:       }
56:       if (player.onGround && slide === 0) slide = SLIDE_FRAMES;
57:     }
58:   };
59:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
60: 
61:   const update = () => {
62:     // player physics
63:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
64:     player.y += player.vy;
65:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.h - 10;
66:     if (player.y >= groundY) { player.y = groundY; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true; }
67:     if (slide > 0) { slide--; player.h = 15; } else { player.h = 30; }
68:     // obstacles movement
69:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= OB_SPEED);
70:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
71:     if (frame % OB_SPACING === 0) createObstacle();
72:     // clouds movement (parallax)
73:     clouds.forEach(c => c.x -= CLOUD_SPEED);
74:     while (clouds.length && clouds[0].x + clouds[0].w < 0) clouds.shift();
75:     if (frame % CLOUD_SPACING === 0) {
76:       const cloudW = 60 + Math.random() * 40;
77:       const cloudH = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
78:       const cloudY = 20 + Math.random() * (canvas.height * 0.3);
79:       clouds.push({ x: canvas.width, y: cloudY, w: cloudW, h: cloudH });
80:     }
81:     frame++;
82:     // collision detection
83:     for (const o of obstacles) {
84:       if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x && player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y) {
85:         playGameOverSound();
86:         alert('Game Over');
87:         document.location.reload();
88:         break;
89:       }
90:     }
91:   };
92: 
93:   const draw = () => {
94:     // background gradient sky
95:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
96:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light sky
97:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // deeper sky
98:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
99:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
100:     // ground
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
102:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 10, canvas.width, 10);
103:     // player as a rounded rectangle
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
105:     const radius = 6;
106:     ctx.beginPath();
107:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
108:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, player.y);
109:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + radius);
110:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - radius);
111:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - radius, player.y + player.h);
112:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.h);
113:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - radius);
114:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
115:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
116:     ctx.fill();
117:     // obstacles with varying colors
118:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
119:       if (o.type === 0) {
120:         ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c'; // low obstacle red
121:       } else {
122:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12'; // high obstacle orange
123:       }
124:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
125:     });
126:     // draw clouds (simple ellipses)
127:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
128:     clouds.forEach(c => {
129:       ctx.beginPath();
130:       ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w/2, c.y + c.h/2, c.w/2, c.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
131:       ctx.fill();
132:     });
133:     // score display
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
135:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
136:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(frame/10)}` , 10, 30);
137:   };
138: 
139:   const loop = () => { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
140:   loop();
141: })();
